text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey kiddo, got a second?
Where are your mom and dad?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... My mom and dad?
I think they're at home, but...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"So, you came to run an errand all by yourself?
Do you know your way home? Are you having any trouble?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I'm a student at Tracen Academy, you see...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, ahh! I'm so sorry! I got the wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all! Um...
I'm sorry for being so misleading myself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Do I really look that childish...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Nishino Flower ended up feeling down because she was treated like a little kid.
